title: Shortening a bounded finite-presentation flat affine complex by residue vanishing
statement: Let S be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and B a cochain complex of O_S-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] concentrated in [0,b], for b∈ℕ. Assume every term is flat over id_S, quasi-coherent, and finitely presented. Let d∈ℕ. Suppose for every s∈S and q∈ℕ with d<q, the homology H^q((fromSpecResidueField s)*B) is zero. Then there is D on the same S concentrated in [0,d], termwise flat and quasi-coherent, whose global-section ring complex is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex], and H^q(g*D)≅H^q(g*B) for every scheme morphism g:T′→S and q∈ℕ [def-pc-base-change].

source.place: Tags 068V (residue criterion, specialized to bounded projective complexes), 064U (finite free representatives), 08EB (affine model)

proof.text: Apply the cancellation construction to obtain D supported in [0,d], flat, quasi-coherent, finitely presented, and a homotopy equivalence e:D≃B.
Apply the bounded-above affine finite-presentation flat pseudo-coherence lemma to D.

For each g:T′→S map e using Functor.mapHomotopyEquiv for the additive pullback functor, and apply HomotopyEquiv.toHomologyIso in integer degree q. This proves the universal pullback comparison without any exactness assumption on pullback.
